spellbook.finance/limitations: An empty list means the workspace has no saved alert matching the filter. It never means an asset is unwatched by another workspace.
status is the last state SpellBook stored. A triggered alert is not evaluated again by this read.
Delegated reads require workspace membership, and membership remains backend-enforced.

description: Read every price alert and buylist watch saved in one workspace, one row per alert with its type, asset, direction and threshold when it has them, status, trigger fields and last matched keys. Filter by status or alertType. Call it before spellbook_alert_create to see what the seller already watches, and use the alertId on a row with spellbook_alert_delete. It reports saved alerts and does not evaluate them or say whether a price would trigger one today.

alertType.description: Return only alerts of this type, such as buylist_watch. Omit to include every type.

status.description: Return only alerts in this status. Omit to include every status.

workspaceId.description: The workspace whose alerts to read, from spellbook_workspaces_list. Required.

name: spellbook_alerts_list
